scope: Bounded real-endpoint E1 adapter. Eleven complete new theorem proofs and two finite-carrier definitions; source-only. Complete 792-LF prior source copied as written dependency; original natural-endpoint chain unchanged. Actual count is proved by quotient injection and actual ceil/floor APIs, not supplied as a hypothesis. No compilation, checking, linter or new subagent.

literal_manuscript.literal_source:
1. An elementary short-interval divisor bound

For integer k>=2, let d_k(n) be the number of ordered k-tuples of positive
integers with product n. If I is an interval in [1,Z], Z>=2, of length Y,
then

 sum_(n in I) d_k(n)
 <= k*[Y*(1+log Z)^(k-1)+Z^(1-1/k)*(1+log Z)^(k-2)].       (E1)

Proof. For every ordered tuple choose a largest coordinate (use the first
one in a tie). If its value is v and the product of the other coordinates
is d, then v>=n^(1/k), so d<=n^(1-1/k)<=D=Z^(1-1/k).
There are at most k choices of its position. For each ordered remaining
tuple of product d, the condition dv in I permits at most Y/d+1 integers
v. Dropping the requirement that v be largest only increases the count.
Therefore the left side is at most

 k*sum_(d<=D) d_(k-1)(d)*(Y/d+1).

The elementary product expansions give, for j>=1,

 sum_(d<=D) d_j(d)/d <= (1+log D)^j,
 sum_(d<=D) d_j(d) <= D*(1+log D)^(j-1).

For the second inequality, sum the last factor with floor(D/product)
and then use the first inequality for the other j-1 factors; j=1 is
immediate. Substitution proves (E1). All endpoints and locations of I
are allowed; no coprimality condition or arithmetic progression is used.
literal_manuscript.quantifiers: K>=2,Z>=2,an interval in [1,Z] of any nonnegative real length Y; exact K prefactor and no positive or root-sized Y lower bound.

complete_new_declarations.name: card_nat_ceiling_floor_le_length_add_one
complete_new_declarations.complete_declaration_source:
theorem card_nat_ceiling_floor_le_length_add_one {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ((Icc ⌈a⌉₊ ⌊b⌋₊).card : ℝ) ≤ b - a + 1 := by
  by_cases hcf : ⌈a⌉₊ ≤ ⌊b⌋₊
  · have hsub : ⌈a⌉₊ ≤ ⌊b⌋₊ + 1 := by omega
    rw [Nat.card_Icc, Nat.cast_sub hsub, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    have hlo : a ≤ (⌈a⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil a
    have hhi : (⌊b⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ b := Nat.floor_le (ha.trans hab)
    linarith
  · have hempty : (Icc ⌈a⌉₊ ⌊b⌋₊ : Finset ℕ) = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro n hn
      obtain ⟨hcn, hnf⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn
      exact hcf (hcn.trans hnf)
    rw [hempty]
    simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
    linarith
complete_new_declarations.review: Explicit nonempty/empty cases. In the nonempty case card_Icc and justified cast_sub give floor(b)+1-ceil(a); floor_le and le_ceil bound this by b-a+1. In the empty case endpoint inequalities contradict membership and hab makes the right side nonnegative.

complete_new_declarations.complete_written_type:
theorem real_supported_multiples_card_le (S : Finset ℕ) {a b : ℝ} {d : ℕ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, a ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    ((S.filter (fun n => d ∣ n)).card : ℝ) ≤ (b - a) / (d : ℝ) + 1 := by
complete_new_declarations.complete_declaration_source:
theorem real_supported_multiples_card_le (S : Finset ℕ) {a b : ℝ} {d : ℕ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, a ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    ((S.filter (fun n => d ∣ n)).card : ℝ) ≤ (b - a) / (d : ℝ) + 1 := by
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun n : ℕ => n / d) (S.filter (fun n => d ∣ n))
      (Icc ⌈a / (d : ℝ)⌉₊ ⌊b / (d : ℝ)⌋₊) := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hnS, hdn⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
    have hq : ((n / d : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) :=
      Nat.cast_div_charZero hdn
    apply Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
    constructor
    · apply Nat.ceil_le.mpr
      rw [hq]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hS n hnS).1 hdR.le
    · apply Nat.le_floor
      rw [hq]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hS n hnS).2 hdR.le
  have hinj : (S.filter (fun n => d ∣ n) : Set ℕ).InjOn (fun n => n / d) := by
    intro n hn m hm hnm
    have hdn : d ∣ n := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    have hdm : d ∣ m := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2
    calc
      n = (n / d) * d := (Nat.div_mul_cancel hdn).symm
      _ = (m / d) * d := congrArg (fun q : ℕ => q * d) hnm
      _ = m := Nat.div_mul_cancel hdm
  have hcard : (S.filter (fun n => d ∣ n)).card ≤
      (Icc ⌈a / (d : ℝ)⌉₊ ⌊b / (d : ℝ)⌋₊).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun n : ℕ => n / d) hmaps hinj
  have hcardR :
      ((S.filter (fun n => d ∣ n)).card : ℝ) ≤
        ((Icc ⌈a / (d : ℝ)⌉₊ ⌊b / (d : ℝ)⌋₊).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcard
  have hquot := card_nat_ceiling_floor_le_length_add_one
    (div_nonneg ha hdR.le) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hab hdR.le)
  calc
    ((S.filter (fun n => d ∣ n)).card : ℝ) ≤
        ((Icc ⌈a / (d : ℝ)⌉₊ ⌊b / (d : ℝ)⌋₊).card : ℝ) := hcardR
    _ ≤ b / (d : ℝ) - a / (d : ℝ) + 1 := hquot
    _ = (b - a) / (d : ℝ) + 1 := by rw [sub_div]
complete_new_declarations.review: Inject actual d-multiples by n/d into Icc ceil(a/d) floor(b/d). Literal divisibility permits cast_div_charZero; positive d permits division of both true support inequalities. Reconstructing n=(n/d)*d proves injectivity. card_le_card_of_injOn and the preceding fully proved cardinal estimate give exactly (b-a)/d+1.

theorem sum_real_supported_divisor_weights_le (S : Finset ℕ) {a b : ℝ} {D : ℕ}

complete_new_declarations.name: sum_fouvryTau_real_support_floor_payment
complete_new_declarations.complete_written_type:
theorem sum_fouvryTau_real_support_floor_payment (S : Finset ℕ) {K : ℕ}
    (hK : 2 ≤ K) {a b Z : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hZ : 2 ≤ Z) (hbZ : b ≤ Z)
    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, a ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, (fouvryTau K n : ℝ)) ≤
      (K : ℝ) * ((b - a) *
        (∑ d ∈ Icc 1 ⌊realDeletionRadius K Z⌋₊,
          (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) +
        ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 ⌊realDeletionRadius K Z⌋₊, (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ)) := by
complete_new_declarations.complete_declaration_source:
theorem sum_fouvryTau_real_support_floor_payment (S : Finset ℕ) {K : ℕ}
    (hK : 2 ≤ K) {a b Z : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hZ : 2 ≤ Z) (hbZ : b ≤ Z)
    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, a ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, (fouvryTau K n : ℝ)) ≤
      (K : ℝ) * ((b - a) *
        (∑ d ∈ Icc 1 ⌊realDeletionRadius K Z⌋₊,
          (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) +
        ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 ⌊realDeletionRadius K Z⌋₊, (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ)) := by
  let D : ℕ := ⌊realDeletionRadius K Z⌋₊
  change (∑ n ∈ S, (fouvryTau K n : ℝ)) ≤
    (K : ℝ) * ((b - a) *
      (∑ d ∈ Icc 1 D, (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) +
      ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 D, (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ))
  have hpoint : ∀ n ∈ S, (fouvryTau K n : ℝ) ≤
      (K : ℝ) * ∑ d ∈ (Icc 1 D).filter (fun d => d ∣ n),
        (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) := by
    intro n hn
    have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith : 0 < a) (hS n hn).1
    have hnpos : 0 < n := by exact_mod_cast hnR
    have hcut : n ^ (K - 1) < (D + 1) ^ K :=
      floor_radius_strict_cutoff hK (by linarith : 1 ≤ Z) ((hS n hn).2.trans hbZ)
    have hnat := fouvryTau_le_truncated_divisor_sum_strict hK
      (by omega : 1 ≤ n) hcut
    rw [truncated_divisor_carrier_eq hnpos] at hnat
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ S, (fouvryTau K n : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ n ∈ S, (K : ℝ) *
          ∑ d ∈ (Icc 1 D).filter (fun d => d ∣ n), (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hpoint
    _ = (K : ℝ) * (∑ n ∈ S,
        ∑ d ∈ (Icc 1 D).filter (fun d => d ∣ n), (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ)) :=
      (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ (K : ℝ) * ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 D,
        (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) * ((b - a) / (d : ℝ) + 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (sum_real_supported_divisor_weights_le S (fun d => (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ))
          (by linarith : 0 ≤ a) hab hS (fun d _hd => Nat.cast_nonneg _))
        (Nat.cast_nonneg K)
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      calc
        (∑ d ∈ Icc 1 D, (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) * ((b - a) / (d : ℝ) + 1)) =
            ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 D, ((b - a) *
              ((fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) + (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro d _hd
          ring
        _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
complete_new_declarations.review: Every supported n is positive and n<=b<=Z. Apply the complete prior floor_radius_strict_cutoff to n with common D=floor(R). Apply native strict tau truncation, cast and sum, use the exact real-supported weighted count, then distribute to reciprocal and ordinary sums.

theorem sum_fouvryTau_E1_real_support (S : Finset ℕ) {K : ℕ}
    (hK : 2 ≤ K) {a b Z : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hZ : 2 ≤ Z) (hbZ : b ≤ Z)
    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, a ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, (fouvryTau K n : ℝ)) ≤
      (K : ℝ) * ((b - a) * (1 + Real.log Z) ^ (K - 1) +
        Z ^ (1 - 1 / (K : ℝ)) * (1 + Real.log Z) ^ (K - 2)) := by

theorem sum_fouvryTau_E1_real_interval_length {K : ℕ} (hK : 2 ≤ K)
    {a Z Y : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hZ : 2 ≤ Z) (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (haYZ : a + Y ≤ Z)
    (I : Set ℝ) (hI : I ⊆ Set.Icc a (a + Y)) :
    (∑ n ∈ realIntervalPoints a (a + Y) I, (fouvryTau K n : ℝ)) ≤
      (K : ℝ) * (Y * (1 + Real.log Z) ^ (K - 1) +
        Z ^ (1 - 1 / (K : ℝ)) * (1 + Real.log Z) ^ (K - 2)) := by
  have hlength : a + Y - a = Y := by ring
  have h := sum_fouvryTau_E1_real_interval hK ha (by linarith : a ≤ a + Y)
    hZ haYZ I hI
  simpa only [hlength] using h

theorem le_floor_iff (ha : 0 ≤ a) : n ≤ ⌊a⌋₊ ↔ (n : α) ≤ a :=
  FloorSemiring.gc_floor ha

theorem le_floor (h : (n : α) ≤ a) : n ≤ ⌊a⌋₊ :=
  (le_floor_iff ((FloorSemiring.natCast_nonneg n).trans h)).2 h

theorem gc_ceil_coe : GaloisConnection (ceil : α → ℕ) (↑) :=
  FloorSemiring.gc_ceil

@[simp]
theorem ceil_le : ⌈a⌉₊ ≤ n ↔ a ≤ n :=
  gc_ceil_coe _ _

theorem floor_lt (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ⌊a⌋₊ < n ↔ a < n :=
  lt_iff_lt_of_le_iff_le <| le_floor_iff ha

theorem floor_lt_one (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ⌊a⌋₊ < 1 ↔ a < 1 :=
  (floor_lt ha).trans <| by rw [Nat.cast_one]

theorem floor_le (ha : 0 ≤ a) : (⌊a⌋₊ : R) ≤ a :=
  (le_floor_iff ha).1 le_rfl

theorem floor_eq_iff (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ⌊a⌋₊ = n ↔ ↑n ≤ a ∧ a < ↑n + 1 := by
  rw [← le_floor_iff ha, ← Nat.cast_one, ← Nat.cast_add, ← floor_lt ha, Nat.lt_add_one_iff,
    le_antisymm_iff, and_comm]

theorem lt_of_floor_lt (h : ⌊a⌋₊ < n) : a < n :=
  lt_of_not_ge fun h' => (le_floor h').not_gt h

theorem lt_one_of_floor_lt_one (h : ⌊a⌋₊ < 1) : a < 1 := mod_cast lt_of_floor_lt h

theorem lt_succ_floor (a : R) : a < ⌊a⌋₊.succ :=
  lt_of_floor_lt <| Nat.lt_succ_self _

@[bound]
theorem lt_floor_add_one (a : R) : a < ⌊a⌋₊ + 1 := by simpa using lt_succ_floor a

theorem add_one_le_ceil_iff : n + 1 ≤ ⌈a⌉₊ ↔ (n : R) < a := by
  rw [← Nat.lt_ceil, Nat.add_one_le_iff]

@[simp]
theorem one_le_ceil_iff : 1 ≤ ⌈a⌉₊ ↔ 0 < a := by
  rw [← zero_add 1, Nat.add_one_le_ceil_iff, Nat.cast_zero]

@[bound]
theorem le_ceil (a : R) : a ≤ ⌈a⌉₊ :=
  ceil_le.1 le_rfl

variable {K : Type*} [DivisionSemiring K] {d m n : ℕ}

@[simp]
lemma cast_div (hnm : n ∣ m) (hn : (n : K) ≠ 0) : (↑(m / n) : K) = m / n := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hnm
  have : n ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hn
  rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ <| zero_lt_of_ne_zero this, mul_comm n,
    cast_mul, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hn]

variable [CharZero K]

@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma cast_div_charZero (hnm : n ∣ m) : (↑(m / n) : K) = m / n := by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0 <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma card_Icc : #(Icc a b) = b + 1 - a := List.length_range' ..
@[simp] lemma card_Ico : #(Ico a b) = b - a := List.length_range' ..
@[simp] lemma card_Ioc : #(Ioc a b) = b - a := List.length_range' ..
@[simp] lemma card_Ioo : #(Ioo a b) = b - a - 1 := List.length_range' ..

protected theorem mul_div_cancel' {n m : Nat} (H : n ∣ m) : n * (m / n) = m := by
  have := mod_add_div m n
  rwa [mod_eq_zero_of_dvd H, Nat.zero_add] at this

protected theorem div_mul_cancel {n m : Nat} (H : n ∣ m) : m / n * n = m := by
  rw [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_div_cancel' H]

lemma card_le_card_of_injOn (f : α → β) (hf : Set.MapsTo f s t) (f_inj : (s : Set α).InjOn f) :
    #s ≤ #t := by
  classical
  calc
    #s = #(s.image f) := (card_image_of_injOn f_inj).symm
    _ ≤ #t := card_le_card <| image_subset_iff.2 hf

@[mono, gcongr, bound]
lemma div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hab : a ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) : a / c ≤ b / c := by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv a c, div_eq_mul_inv b c]
  gcongr; exact Right.inv_nonneg.2 hc

@[to_additive]
theorem prod_mul_distrib : ∏ x ∈ s, f x * g x = (∏ x ∈ s, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s, g x :=
  Eq.trans (by rw [one_mul]; rfl) fold_op_distrib

@[to_additive]
theorem prod_filter (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : ι → M) :
    ∏ a ∈ s with p a, f a = ∏ a ∈ s, if p a then f a else 1 :=
  calc
    ∏ a ∈ s with p a, f a = ∏ a ∈ s with p a, if p a then f a else 1 :=
      prod_congr rfl fun a h => by rw [if_pos]; simpa using (mem_filter.1 h).2
    _ = ∏ a ∈ s, if p a then f a else 1 := by
      { refine prod_subset (filter_subset _ s) fun x hs h => ?_
        rw [mem_filter, not_and] at h
        exact if_neg (by simpa using h hs) }

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_const (b : M) : ∏ _x ∈ s, b = b ^ #s :=
  (congr_arg _ <| s.val.map_const b).trans <| Multiset.prod_replicate #s b

@[to_additive]
theorem prod_comm {s : Finset γ} {t : Finset α} {f : γ → α → β} :
    (∏ x ∈ s, ∏ y ∈ t, f x y) = ∏ y ∈ t, ∏ x ∈ s, f x y :=
  prod_comm' fun _ _ => Iff.rfl

lemma sum_mul (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * a = ∑ i ∈ s, f i * a := map_sum (AddMonoidHom.mulRight a) _ s

lemma mul_sum (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R) :
    a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i = ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i := map_sum (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft a) _ s

@[simp] lemma nsmul_eq_mul (n : ℕ) (a : α) : n • a = n * a := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [zero_nsmul, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
  | succ n ih => rw [succ_nsmul, ih, Nat.cast_succ, add_mul, one_mul]

def fouvryTau (k : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℕ := ArithmeticFunction.zeta ^ k

@[simp] theorem fouvryTau_zero (k : ℕ) : fouvryTau k 0 = 0 :=
  ArithmeticFunction.map_zero

theorem fouvryTau_multiplicative (k : ℕ) : (fouvryTau k).IsMultiplicative :=
  ArithmeticFunction.isMultiplicative_zeta.pow

@[simp] theorem fouvryTau_one (k : ℕ) : fouvryTau k 1 = 1 :=
  (fouvryTau_multiplicative k).map_one

theorem fouvryTau_order_one {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : fouvryTau 1 n = 1 := by
  simp [fouvryTau, ArithmeticFunction.zeta_apply, hn]

theorem fouvryTau_succ (k n : ℕ) :
    fouvryTau (k + 1) n = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, fouvryTau k d := by
  exact ArithmeticFunction.coe_mul_zeta_apply (f := fouvryTau k)

theorem sum_fouvryTau_div_le (k N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, (fouvryTau k n : ℝ) / n) ≤ (1 + Real.log N) ^ k := by
  exact (sum_reciprocalTau_le k N).trans
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (reciprocalSum_nonneg _) (reciprocalSum_le_log _) _)

/-- Reciprocal divisor means at a real endpoint. -/
theorem sum_fouvryTau_div_le_real (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (fouvryTau k n : ℝ) / n) ≤ (1 + Real.log x) ^ k := by
  have heq : reciprocalSum ⌊x⌋₊ = (harmonic ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
    have hI : Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊ = Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊ := by
      ext; simp only [mem_Ioc, mem_Icc]; omega
    simp [reciprocalSum, harmonic_eq_sum_Icc, hI]
  exact (sum_reciprocalTau_le k ⌊x⌋₊).trans
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (reciprocalSum_nonneg _)
      (heq ▸ harmonic_floor_le_one_add_log x hx) _)

/-- Real-endpoint form, uniform in `x`, with the order kept explicit. -/
theorem sum_fouvryTau_le_real {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (fouvryTau k n : ℝ)) ≤
      x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ (k - 1) := by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : k ≠ 0)
  have hfloor : 1 ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by simpa using hx)
  have hlog : 1 + Real.log (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ 1 + Real.log x := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < ⌊x⌋₊ by omega))
      (Nat.floor_le (by linarith : 0 ≤ x))
    linarith
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
    have := Real.log_nonneg (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ by exact_mod_cast hfloor)
    linarith
  simpa only [Nat.succ_sub_one] using
    (sum_fouvryTau_le j ⌊x⌋₊).trans
      (mul_le_mul (Nat.floor_le (by linarith)) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hnonneg hlog j)
        (pow_nonneg hnonneg j) (by linarith : 0 ≤ x))

lemma Ioc_filter_dvd_eq :
    {x ∈ Ioc a b | r ∣ x} =
      (Ioc ⌊a / (r : ℚ)⌋ ⌊b / (r : ℚ)⌋).map ⟨(· * r), mul_left_injective₀ hr.ne'⟩ := by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_map, mem_filter, mem_Ioc, floor_lt, le_floor, div_lt_iff₀, le_div_iff₀,
    dvd_iff_exists_eq_mul_left, cast_pos.2 hr, ← cast_mul, cast_lt, cast_le]
  aesop

/-- There are `⌈b / r⌉ - ⌈a / r⌉` multiples of `r` in `[a, b)`, if `a ≤ b`. -/
theorem Ico_filter_dvd_card : #{x ∈ Ico a b | r ∣ x} = max (⌈b / (r : ℚ)⌉ - ⌈a / (r : ℚ)⌉) 0 := by
  rw [Ico_filter_dvd_eq _ _ hr, card_map, card_Ico, toNat_eq_max]

/-- There are `⌊b / r⌋ - ⌊a / r⌋` multiples of `r` in `(a, b]`, if `a ≤ b`. -/
theorem Ioc_filter_dvd_card : #{x ∈ Ioc a b | r ∣ x} = max (⌊b / (r : ℚ)⌋ - ⌊a / (r : ℚ)⌋) 0 := by
  rw [Ioc_filter_dvd_eq _ _ hr, card_map, card_Ioc, toNat_eq_max]

if `a ≤ b`. `Nat` version of `Int.Ioc_filter_modEq_card`. -/
theorem Ioc_filter_modEq_card (v : ℕ) :
    #{x ∈ Ioc a b | x ≡ v [MOD r]} = max (⌊(b - v) / (r : ℚ)⌋ - ⌊(a - v) / (r : ℚ)⌋) 0 := by
  simp_rw [← Ioc_filter_modEq_cast _ _ ▸ card_map _,
    Int.Ioc_filter_modEq_card _ _ (cast_lt.mpr hr), Int.cast_natCast]

theorem eq_empty_of_forall_notMem {s : Finset α} (H : ∀ x, x ∉ s) : s = ∅ :=
  eq_of_veq (eq_zero_of_forall_notMem H)

theorem eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem {s : Finset α} : s = ∅ ↔ ∀ x, x ∉ s := by grind

mathematical_chain.actual_count: Inject actual d-multiples by n/d into Icc ceil(a/d) floor(b/d). Handle both nonempty and empty quotient intervals explicitly.
mathematical_chain.floor_domain: Auxiliary count has 0<=a<=b and d>0, hence b/d>=0. Final E1 derives this from 1<=a<=b. No negative-upper-endpoint floor-zero inference is used.
mathematical_chain.finite_exchange: Exact sum_filter/sum_comm and constant sum; nonnegative weights only for multiplying count inequalities.
mathematical_chain.positivity: E1 n>=a>=1; summed d in Icc 1 floor(R), hence d>0. Native tau casts and K are nonnegative.
mathematical_chain.cutoff: Each actual n<=b<=Z gives n^(K-1)<(floor(R)+1)^K by the complete prior strict cutoff; never assert floor(R)^K>=Z^(K-1).
mathematical_chain.means: Use complete prior native_floor_tau_payment at R=Z^((K-1)/K), Y=b-a>=0 and 1<=R<=Z. Actual native means preserve coefficients 1,R and exponents K-1,K-2.
mathematical_chain.exact_carrier: realIntervalPoints a b I filters Icc ceil(a) floor(b) by cast n in I. Its membership theorem proves equivalence with cast n in I under I subset Icc a b; it drops no real interval natural point.
mathematical_chain.endpoint_modes: For Set.Icc use identity inclusion; Set.Ioc weakens its lower strict inequality, Ico its upper, Ioo both. The universal I-subset statement includes all four modes and arbitrary subsets without another endpoint allowance.
mathematical_chain.length: Set b=a+Y and prove b-a=Y. hY>=0 is only inherent length nonnegativity, with no added size threshold.
mathematical_chain.exact_prefactor: Exactly K from the indexed deletion cover, with no factor two, enlarged radius or changed log.
mathematical_chain.native_tau: Actual fouvryTau is ArithmeticFunction.zeta^K, identified with the full ordered factor carrier by the complete prior dependency.

edge_cases: Y=0: a closed singleton may contain one integer, paid by +1; open/half-open degeneracies may be empty. No division by Y.
0<Y<1: true Y remains in the main term; a singleton is paid only through the existing +1 payment.
ceil(a/d)>floor(b/d): quotient carrier is explicitly empty; hab makes the target nonnegative.
a=0 in auxiliary count: zero can be in generic S and its quotient is 0; injection and closed-card count are still correct. Final E1 has a>=1.
d=0 excluded before real division payment; all actual divisor weights use positive d.
K=2: ordinary tau order 1 and K-2=0 remain literal and permitted by native means.
Z=2 and integral radius: inherited bounds 1<=R<=Z and the strict successor cutoff remain valid.
Empty S or I: finite sums/carriers total, with no nonempty-support assumption.
